idea-plugin.name: CodeBridge Bundled Extensions
idea-plugin.description:
Runs the VS Code extensions other plugins ship. A plugin made from a VS Code extension depends on this, so the extension works as one of the IDE's own features: you don't need VS Code or Node.js installed, and nothing else of VS Code comes with it.

To browse and install VS Code extensions yourself, and to use a project's .vscode folder, install CodeBridge.
